free_text.text: Global macros for sample/covariate definitions ($X_cf for covariates, $data_dir for data directory)
Sample restricted by hasGoodSSN==1 for employment outcome
Three source files analyzed: causal forest estimation in R, RCT heterogeneous treatment effect analysis in Stata, and custom prediction helper function. All key stages traced.
Global variable naming: maindirectory, codedir, datadir, outdir, adobase for path management
Seed set to fixed value for reproducibility

Focused on main experiment RCT design and main/follow-up table specifications. Multiple experiments across 6 datasets (main, follow-up, 2 online surveys, recruitment, arab barometer) not fully covered. Attrition and Lee bounds identified but detailed bounds values not extracted.
Core Uganda RCT: pdslasso ANCOVA main specs, event study, heterogeneity, entropy weighting; Kenya extension with areg and ritest; Anderson sharpened q-values for multiple testing correction
Specification naming: areg models stored as A1, A2, B1, B2, etc.; conditional on local switch variables
Separate Prep and Analysis branches; Preparation switched by global $Preparation, Analyses by global $Analyses
Analysis restricted to workers surveyed at baseline who match with production records

Read master script and main analysis files for line-level and line-section-level regressions. Paper is an RCT in factory setting examining effects of religious composition on team production and worker behavior. Treatment is assignment of religious composition (mixed vs homogeneous) to production teams.

RCT with digital collateral for school-fee loans in Uganda. Three treatment arms: lockout-secured, surprise unsecured, unsecured control. Main analysis via IV (2SLS) of compliance on repayment/completion with three-way decomposition. Heterogeneous effects by risk and WTP.
Master script 0_0_master.do with pipeline: clean, randomization, analysis, tables. Reghdfe with lasso selection and sharpened q-values.
Panel data structure: xtset id year for event study; appuser and letter_dummy capture treatment assignment

Main pipeline traced: 2 data prep files (event study & RCT), 3 main analysis files. Event study uses DiD with time-varying treatment timing. RCT implements ITT and LATE with 2SLS using predicted app adoption as instrument. Mechanism analysis compares 3 letter treatments. Appendix files not read due to budget.
